title: Band gap extraction task contract

model_response.description: Keys are displayed evidence IDs. Empty object means abstention.

response.description: Public observation tuples [original value, original unit, origin, evidence sentence]. Empty list means no supported observation.

method.exp: this paper's experimental measurement or experimental fit

archive.description: Method detail and gap type are explicit evidence cues, not inferred labels.

rules: A value requires a named energy unit and traceable evidence for the target and sample.
Reject wavelength-only claims, missing units, range or bound endpoints and non-gap energy cues.
Capture a stated center for x ± u; retain the original numeric spelling and entire evidence span.
Normalization is deterministic; unit family is energy; 0–15 eV inclusive is a screening range.

validation.reference: Same source and same anchored passage, with unit, method and evidence sentence matched to the published annotation.
validation.replay: Same frozen input, policy, engine, decoding configuration; recheck schema and compare outputs.
